topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the topic of complement and frames the lecture within the course.

topics.label: Foundations and Overview of the Complement System
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the overarching architecture, nomenclature conventions, and the central role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct biochemical pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on C3 deposition.

topics.label: Complement Effector Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the functional immunological outcomes triggered downstream of complement activation to eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement damage.

topics.label: Clinical Consequences of Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the specific clinical presentations and disease phenotypes associated with deficiencies in various complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of the Complement System
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the strategies and mechanisms evolved by microorganisms to avoid complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the discussion on complement and previews the upcoming topic on the adaptive immune system.
